title: When the Machine Breaks
author: Orsen Sterling
blurb: Rosalind Okonkwo, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
